subject: SensorCloud onboarding — request for invoice-only (no-PO) fastlane
messages:
From: Allison Park <allison.park@sensorcloud.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) fastlane

Hi Dev,

Thanks again for the demo last week — SensorCloud is excited about integrating Redwood inference into our pipeline. Our finance team is ready to start vendor setup, but we have a preference for an invoice-only path (we do not issue POs from our AP system for small, SaaS pilot partners).

Can we be onboarded as an invoice recipient (Net 30) for an initial pilot? If a PO is required as a hard policy, let us know the thresholds/required approvals — we may be able to accept a retroactive PO if needed, but that adds friction for our procurement.

I've attached the W-9 and our COI per your vendor intake checklist. I can also provide a signed SOW or proof of insurance if that helps.

Attachments: SensorCloud_W9.pdf (application/pdf), SensorCloud_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk through the docs.

Allison Park
Head of Finance, SensorCloud Inc.
allison.park@sensorcloud.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Park <allison.park@sensorcloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) fastlane

Hi Allison — thanks for sending the docs and for the quick follow-up. Looping in Hannah (procurement) and Grace (customer ops) so we can align on an onboarding path.

Short answers up front: we typically require a PO for services and SaaS engagements to ensure proper invoice routing and budget control. That said, procurement occasionally approves temporary invoice-only exceptions for pilot engagements under controlled conditions.

To accelerate, please:
- Confirm legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the vendor record
- Confirm tax ID (EIN)
- Confirm the billing contact and preferred remit address (email and physical)

I also pasted our vendor intake checklist link here for any missing fields: https://redwood.company/vendor-intake (internal).

If procurement is OK with a pilot exception, we ask that the vendor agree to: 1) Net 30 invoices; 2) invoice amounts under an approved threshold or a capped quarterly limit; 3) provide timely evidence (W-9, COI) — which you already attached.

If you’re open to it, I propose a 90-day invoice-only pilot with a $25k cap per quarter as a starting point. Happy to document this in an MSA addendum or short SOW.

Would you like me to route this for a quick procurement review?

Best,
Dev
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Allison Park <allison.park@sensorcloud.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) fastlane

Thanks, Dev — appreciate the clear options.

SensorCloud confirms:
- Legal name: SensorCloud Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Billing contact: accounts@sensorcloud.com (remit to: invoices@sensorcloud.com)

We are ok with Net 30 and a conditional 90-day pilot. The $25k/quarter cap is acceptable for the initial phase — we can revisit when the pilot expands.

Attached are the W-9 and COI again; I've also created a quick DocuSign for a short pilot addendum if you prefer that route: https://docu.sign/sensorcloud-onboard

Let me know what procurement needs from our side to approve the invoice-only fastlane. If there are additional small evidentiary items (e.g., SOC/ISO attestations) we can provide the documents or an access window.

Regards,
Allison

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SensorCloud onboarding — proposal for conditional invoice-only pilot (context + recommendation)

Hannah / Grace — forwarding SensorCloud’s request and docs. Summary and my recommendation below.

On Fri, Nov 05, 2027 at 08:55 Allison Park <allison.park@sensorcloud.com> wrote:
> SensorCloud confirms: Legal name: SensorCloud Inc.; EIN: 12-3456789; billing contact: accounts@sensorcloud.com
> Attachments: SensorCloud_W9.pdf, SensorCloud_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf

Why I recommend a controlled exception:
- Business: SensorCloud is a strategic pilot (low ramp, strong reference potential in healthcare IoT). Fast onboarding accelerates evaluation and increases likelihood of expansion.
- Risk controls: we have W-9 + COI; they’ve agreed to Net 30; we can cap spend at $25k/quarter for 90 days.
- Operational notes: Sales will collect invoices and route to AP inbox; vendor should include invoice metadata (invoice# + project code) so we can reconcile without a PO.
- Additional controls if needed: require primary contact on each invoice, monthly statement uploads into our vendor portal, and a written acknowledgement of the cap (DocuSign).

Proposed decision: approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for SensorCloud (90 days, $25k cap per quarter) conditioned on: W-9/COI on file, vendor signs short addendum acknowledging cap and Net 30, and their invoices include required metadata. We can require retroactive PO creation only if spend exceeds $25k in that quarter.

If this aligns with procurement tolerance, please confirm and I’ll submit a formal vendor setup request and the SOW/addendum for signature.

Thanks,
Dev

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: SensorCloud onboarding — proposal for conditional invoice-only pilot (context + recommendation)

+1 on Dev’s recommendation. Procurement approves a temporary invoice-only "fastlane" for SensorCloud Inc. under the following conditions: 

1) Term: 90 days from vendor activation.
2) Spend cap: $25,000 per calendar quarter. Any spend beyond the cap requires a PO or explicit procurement sign-off.
3) Evidence: W-9 and COI must be on file before first invoice is paid.
4) Invoicing requirements: invoices must include vendor legal name, invoice number, Redwood project code, and the sales rep name in the header. AP will reject invoices that do not contain the required metadata.
5) Contracting: Sales to attach a one-paragraph addendum (DocuSign link OK) stating the cap and Net 30 payment terms. The addendum must be retained in the vendor file.

Dev — proceed with vendor setup and send the addendum to Allison for signature. Grace — please add a tracking note in the vendor record and set a procurement review reminder for 2028-02-10 (90-day review).

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
